model.title: A bill to provide for an extension of the legislative authority of the National Emergency Medical Services Memorial Foundation to establish a commemorative work in the District of Columbia and its environs.

summary.lead: Official summary (Congressional Research Service, Introduced in Senate):

blocks.text: This bill extends the authority of the National Emergency Medical Services Memorial Foundation to establish a commemorative work in the District of Columbia that honors the commitment and service of emergency medical services.

This bill lets the National Emergency Medical Services Memorial Foundation continue to set up a memorial in Washington, D.C. The memorial is meant to honor the dedication and service of emergency medical workers.
